findings.evidence: Quotient.lean:46 has `[AddCommGroup C]`; Quotient.lean:211 has `[AddCommGroup P]`; Comodule.lean:49-50 and 108-110 define `Comodule`/`Hom` at `[AddCommMonoid C]`/codomain level, and Comap.lean:51-54 plus 121 show the nearby pattern of using `[AddCommMonoid C]` with a local derived group.
findings.fix: Keep `[AddCommGroup M]` for the quotient module, but weaken `C` and `P` to `[AddCommMonoid ...]` and derive local additive groups from `Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup R` only where Mathlib quotient/tensor lemmas need them, as in `Subcomodule.Comap`.
findings.issue: `quotientCoact`, `instComoduleQuotient`, `mkQ`, and the lift API require `[AddCommGroup C]`, and `liftQ` also requires `[AddCommGroup P]` at line 211, even though `Comodule`/`Comodule.Hom` are stated with `[AddCommMonoid C]` and `[AddCommMonoid P]`.

summary: The quotient construction no longer has the earlier flatness over-assumption, but the exported API still asks for additive-group instances on the coalgebra and codomain where the surrounding comodule API only needs additive monoids.
